run_manage_django_commands: run the Django manage.py entry point to execute management commands via execute_from_command_line
run_start_dev_server: run the Django development server with a custom internal port set from settings.INTERNAL_PORT
configure_django_settings_module: configure the Django settings module to core.settings.label_studio before executing management commands
handle_django_import_errors: handle Django import errors with a helpful message about virtual environment and PYTHONPATH
test_manage_py_entry_point: test the manage.py entry point by running Django management commands like migrate, shell, or check
